title: 35th Annual It's A Gas Swap Meet!
seo_title: 35th Annual It's A Gas Swap Meet in Lebanon, MO
description: This is a swap meet where vendors sell petrolania, vintage advertising, coin-op items, vintage toys, gas pumps, and other items tied to the gas and oil collector's hobby. It is the 35th annual edition of the event. It takes place Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 8:00 AM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, MO.
